name: The Raven Queen
source:
The legend of the Raven Queen has been passed down in this village for generations: anyone who crosses her path is cursed to decay from the inside out. Val wonders why.

[From [url=https://gardenrobot.itch.io/theravenqueen]Itch.io[/url]]
